Method of Attack: Malware infection to air-gapped computers to exfiltrate data
Autonomous filesystem enumeration and exfiltration of files
Transmission of data via internal speaker ultrasound frequencies
Discoverer: Researchers at the School of Cyber Security at Korea University, Seoul
Impacted Systems: Network-isolated systems in critical environments such as government networks, energy infrastructure, and weapon control systems
Attack Vector: Infection by rogue employee or stealthy intruder with physical access
Malware installed on target air-gapped system
